A [[Cloth of the Brotherhood]] can be used to change a single [[hero]]'s armor set to the hero-only [[Brotherhood armor]]. To change a hero's armor, speak to [[Master Armorer Kor]] in [[Central Transfer Chamber]] while that hero is in your party.

Only [[Eye of the North]] heroes are eligible for this armor:

*[[Anton]]
*[[Gwen]]
*[[Hayda]]
*[[Jora]]
*[[Kahmu]]
*[[Livia]]
*[[Ogden Stonehealer]]
*[[Pyre Fierceshot]]
*[[Vekk]]
*[[Xandra]]

==Acquisition==
*[[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]]
**[[Depths of Tyria]] <small>''(accessed from [[Central Transfer Chamber]])''</small>
***[[Glint's Challenge]] 
****[[Chest of the Brotherhood]] <small>(''guaranteed drop for each player to open chest'')</small>
*Opening a [[Paper Wrapped Parcel]].

==Notes==
*Once a hero has been given at least one alternate set of armor, you can switch between any of their unlocked sets at any [[hero armorer]]s corresponding to that hero.
*A hero must be wearing one of their alternate armor sets to be displayed in the [["Fellowship"]] monument in the [[Hall of Monuments]].
